credential_value.algorithm: Set lowerLine = lib.toLower line, remove the first # comment suffix deterministically with builtins.split, then prepend one literal space to produce paddedContentLine. Fail when builtins.match regex paddedContentLine is non-null. The explicit preceding non-[a-z0-9_] boundary and required separator prevent larger-identifier matches; the required non-space/non-# value prevents empty/comment-only values.

executable_command.algorithm: fail when builtins.match regex line is non-null; builtins.match is whole-line, so the trailing .* is deliberate

non_loopback_url_or_host.algorithm: Set lowerLine = lib.toLower line. Use builtins.split url_candidate_split_regex lowerLine, retain only captured URL candidates deterministically, and split each candidate after the scheme at authority_split_regex; every authority must whole-match allowed_authority_regex. A line with one allowed and one forbidden URL fails. Separately use builtins.split bare_candidate_split_regex lowerLine, filter empty fragments, retain tokens whole-matching bare_candidate_regex or bare_ipv6_regex, and reject every retained token except allowed_bare_candidates. Bracketed IPv6 literals and unbracketed concrete IPv6 addresses containing at least two colons are recognized; only ::1 and [::1] are allowed, with a decimal port allowed only in bracketed authority or endpoint syntax. Ordinary undotted prose is never a candidate, Markdown punctuation is a split delimiter, and objectStorage.createLocally is accepted only by its exact lowercased token.

nonempty_assignment.algorithm: fail when builtins.match regex line is non-null; whole-line match is explicit

pem.algorithm: fail when builtins.match regex line is non-null; whole-line match is explicit

positive_host_guidance.algorithm: Set lowerLine = lib.toLower line, split with token_split_regex, and filter empty tokens deterministically. Fail when any whole action token occurs before a later whole host token. hostname and reversed host/action order do not match. The byte-exact sigv4-host normative statement is the sole allowed matching line.

production_absolute_path.algorithm: Prepend one literal space to produce paddedLine, then fail when builtins.match regex paddedLine is non-null; whole-line match and its explicit preceding space-or-code-delimiter boundary are deliberate

final_tree_record_protocol.atomic_reservation_rule: Before delegation/build, helper uses descriptor-keyed same-filesystem mkdir as the sole portable exclusive primitive. It provides process/concurrency/interruption-safe atomic reservation only; no fsync, directory durability, crash/power-loss persistence, atomic-rename durability, or capability preflight is claimed. Only the mkdir holder may invoke once. Concurrent loser or an existing reservation directory after interruption is a zero-action hard blocker; no TTL, reclaim, delete, overwrite, or automatic retry.
final_tree_record_protocol.call_kind_rule: Only exact JSON token call_kind=first is valid for the initial receipt, and only exact JSON token call_kind=fv07_replay is valid for the sole FV07 replay receipt. No other call_kind is valid; blocked calls create no receipt.

canonical_json_hash_protocol.canonical_full_file_rule: Exact full-file bytes must equal jq -cS compact lexicographic-key JSON plus exactly one LF; alternate whitespace, key order, escaping, or encoding fails even if parsing succeeds.
canonical_json_hash_protocol.classification_rule: Terminal/receipt payload hashes are immutable protocol-output hashes only, never a fifth GPE artifact.
canonical_json_hash_protocol.preparse_rejections: Reject duplicate object-member paths before parse, invalid UTF-8, any non-object or wrong top-level field set, and noncanonical bytes/encoding.
canonical_json_hash_protocol.receipt_payload: canonical full object with only receipt_sha256 removed; receipt_sha256 = SHA-256(canonical receipt_payload bytes). The displayed digest is serialized only after payload derivation and verifies canonical parsed payload, not final-file bytes.
canonical_json_hash_protocol.terminal_record_payload: canonical full object with only record_sha256 removed; record_sha256 = SHA-256(canonical terminal_record_payload bytes). The displayed digest is serialized only after payload derivation and verifies canonical parsed payload, not final-file bytes.

final_tree_record_protocol.descriptor_digest_rule: SHA-256 of canonical NUL-delimited target_descriptor_id, exact argv/guarded command, and expected output-map schema.

final_tree_record_protocol.post_action_revalidation_rule: After every Linux/Darwin target action and before terminal success, helper reopens/re-hashes all four GPE paths into the exact canonical map, recomputes full repository source_snapshot, ignored inventory, generated-evidence binding, and descriptor input digest, and compares all including the map/map SHA to the reservation/base key. On equality it may commit build_succeeded with exact output map. Any mismatch, fourth-artifact mutation, truncation, or replacement commits immutable terminal_state=input_drift with terminal_failure_class=input_drift, raw action exit/evidence, all post-action map/comparison fields, and no successful output map; first receipt returns that block/failure and a separately authorized new session is required. If action fails, action_failed takes precedence only when post-action values equal; if both action failure and drift occur, input_drift takes precedence and preserves the raw failed action evidence. No successful record is committed on drift.

prepare_snapshot_subcommand.failure_rule: Any preexisting, duplicate, conflicting, malformed, truncated, or partial GPE path; reservation conflict/interruption; failed exclusive create; staged/read-back byte mismatch including the fourth artifact; map-SHA mismatch; or prepublish/postpublish drift fails closed with no Linux/Darwin action, no overwrite/reuse/rebaseline, and a separately authorized new session. Interruption that leaves partial immutable GPE is a hard blocker; this is not an atomic four-file transaction and claims no power-loss durability.

final_tree_record_protocol.terminal_rule: Holder terminalizes immutable build_succeeded/build_failed/input_drift record with canonical payload record_sha256 and exactly one call_kind=first receipt current=1. No generated protocol evidence artifact inventories or hashes itself; none is explicit_ignored_evidence. generated_evidence_binding_payload includes only its five ordered payload fields and forbids generated_evidence_binding_sha256; the fourth artifact displays that derived digest only after payload hashing. The source-snapshot hash artifact's own byte SHA is linked separately in the four-entry map and is not a source_snapshot component. Task-2 authoring_trace_ref and dispatch json_pointer values are traceability only: neither helper nor runtime catalog dereferences plan/requirements/result artifacts.
production_order: derive closed explicit ignored/external evidence catalog/inventory excluding every generated protocol evidence descriptor/content
derive base coverage oracle only over repository snapshot plus explicit ignored/external evidence
write and canonical-hash repository manifest, ignored inventory, and base coverage oracle
construct canonical generated_evidence_binding_payload from only ordered_payload_fields, derive generated_evidence_binding_sha256, then serialize payload plus displayed derived digest in fourth GPE

derive source_snapshot as tagged NUL-delimited SHA-256 over repository_manifest_sha256, ignored_input_inventory_sha256, input_coverage_oracle_sha256, and derived generated_evidence_binding_sha256; link the enclosing fourth artifact byte SHA only through the separate map entry

final_tree_snapshot.ignored_preexisting_inventory_entry: path, role, producer, SHA-256, classification=explicit-ignored-evidence; inventory contains every ignored generated/frozen preexisting input consumed by G0 or FV01–FV08.
ignored_preexisting_required_roles: Task-2 PF1/matrix frozen evidence records, prompt-span capture metadata, SHA/fingerprint records, and baseline copies not present in repository snapshot; repository-owned authoritative documents remain repository_snapshot only
ignored s1 recorded-digest evidence; the live assertion manifest and lock remain repository_snapshot only
FV01–FV08 authoritative/reference/baseline/evidence inputs not present in repository snapshot
final_tree_snapshot.input_catalog_rule: Stable unique input_id is mandatory. Repository-owned paths classify only repository_snapshot; ignored/external preexisting inputs classify only explicit_ignored_evidence; generated artifacts/records/receipts/results classify only immutable_protocol_output with an explicit subkind. An authoring_trace_ref is traceability only and never a runtime dereference. Every entry has exact producer and nonempty consuming G0/t13/FV stage; duplicate, missing, extra, unclassified, self-referential, or unconsumed entries fail.
final_tree_snapshot.module_eval_binding: Final t13-s5 module-eval is caller-only: it first runs the Nix evaluator and accepts exactly 18 PASS/0 FAIL/0 SKIP, then invokes `scripts/tasks/task-13/final-tree-record.sh prepare-snapshot <recorded-digest>` exactly once, and echoes/binds the helper-returned exact four-entry gpe_artifact_hash_map, gpe_artifact_hash_map_sha256, repository_manifest_sha256, ignored_input_inventory_sha256, input_coverage_oracle_sha256, source_snapshot_hash_artifact_sha256, generated_evidence_binding_sha256, and source_snapshot. Neither the module-eval implementation nor mod.just writes, canonicalizes, or otherwise materializes GPE/state; this remains separate from the immutable s1 assertion digest.
protocol_output_exclusions: first receipts and sole FV07 replay receipts
final_tree_snapshot.protocol_output_hash_linkage: Excluded protocol outputs are never part of base source_snapshot. Current-step raw_result/audit_result/replay receipt hashes are post-dispatch FV outputs and final-handoff fields, never same-step inputs. Only the preexisting matching Linux/Darwin terminal-record and first-receipt hashes may be FV07 pre-step inputs; FV07 replay receipts are outputs.
final_tree_snapshot.repository_input_selection: Every tracked repository path plus every untracked nonignored path, evaluated from the working tree; a tracked path missing from disk is retained as an explicit missing entry.

final_verify.pre_step_snapshot_contract: For each FV01 through FV08 in exact order, final-verify.sh first calls exact helper subcommand `scripts/tasks/task-13/final-tree-record.sh verify-snapshot <recorded-digest> <fv-id>`; it does not compute or classify snapshot inputs itself. Before dispatch a changed/missing/malformed map blocks. After dispatch, final-verify.sh calls the same helper subcommand for the same FV input set before accepting raw output; pre/post source_snapshot, map/map SHA, input-set hash, and step_input_digest must match or drift blocks with no rebaseline.
